instructions: Elliptical slice sampling requires an explicit Gaussian prior structure (prior_mean and prior_cov). The mvn_10 model does not expose this structure in its metadata. This cell requires model parameterization work upstream.
workflow:
Hard-exclusion category 2: Non-differentiable or gradient-degenerate models for gradient-based samplers (elliptical_slice).

Elliptical slice and mgrad_gaussian require explicit Gaussian prior structure (prior_mean and prior_cov parameters). These samplers are excluded for 12 of 14 models in the v1 inventory — only gp_regression and stoch_vol expose the required Gaussian priors.

MVN_10 is a simple multivariate Gaussian, but its recipe definition does not expose prior_mean and prior_cov in the Posterior metadata (the model uses implicit uniform priors over the sample space). Enabling elliptical_slice for mvn_10 would require extending the Posterior schema to record prior structure explicitly.

See RECIPE_GENERATION.md § Hard Exclusions Category 2 (lines 572-574) for the full context.
